overview.headline: Secret debates that produced a new plan of government

keyPoints.point: Delegates debated in secret during the summer to create a new plan of government
keyPoints.quote: Drafted in secret by delegates to the Constitutional Convention during the summer of 1787

keyPoints.point: Members adjourned from day to day until enough states were present to begin work
keyPoints.quote: the members adjourned from day to day until a quorum of seven states was obtained on May 25

keyPoints.point: Discussion made clear that the Convention would draft an entirely new frame of government
keyPoints.quote: rather than amend the existing Articles, the Convention would draft an entirely new frame of government

keyPoints.point: Chief issues included central power and how many representatives each state should allow
keyPoints.quote: how much power to allow the central government, how many representatives in Congress to allow each state

keyTerms.gloss: gathering of delegates meeting during the summer to debate plans
keyTerms.quote: Drafted in secret by delegates to the Constitutional Convention during the summer of 1787

keyTerms.gloss: earlier plan that delegates chose to revise with a new frame
keyTerms.quote: to revise the Articles of Confederation
